title: Review
body: Such a good app to keep track of your progress.
author: Rhageal

title: A Monument
body: This app is a monument and an example of what applications are meant for. To better human lives in ways that could be simple but also life-changing. A monument to the days before paywalls and ads. A monument to the betterment of human beings. Thank you guys, you truly are my couple of friends. God Bless.
author: Itatiro
